forecasts.line: Kurzweil pictures civilization in 2099 running on about ten to the sixtieth calculations per second, vastly beyond any single human brain.

works.author: Ray Kurzweil
works.title: The Singularity Is Near: When Humans Transcend Biology

forecasts.line: Kurzweil expects the mostly nonbiological intelligence of a merged human-machine civilization to dwarf today's by an immense factor by 2099.
